Essex County Family Court

Court Address & Contact Information

  • Address: 212 Washington St, Newark, NJ 07102, United States
  • Google Maps Code: PRQG+2G Newark, New Jersey, USA
  • Phone: (973) 776-9300
  • Website: New Jersey Courts – Family Division

Operating Hours

  • Monday – Friday: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Saturday – Sunday: Closed

The Essex County Family Court is a specialized court that handles a range of legal matters related to families and children. It plays a crucial role in resolving disputes and protecting the rights and interests of individuals and families in the county.

History of Essex County Family Court

The history of the family court system in Essex County dates back to the early 20th century when family law was first established. Over the years, the court has evolved to meet the changing needs of families and to provide a more efficient and effective way to resolve legal disputes.

Overview of Essex County Family Court Services

The Essex County Family Court handles a variety of cases, including child custody, child support, domestic violence, division of marital property, alimony, adoption, paternity, juvenile delinquency, and more. The judges of the family court are responsible for ensuring that all cases are handled fairly and justly, and that the rights of all parties are protected.

The Family Court Process in Essex County

The family court process in Essex County typically begins with the filing of a case. Once a case has been filed, the court will take several steps to resolve the dispute, including mediation and alternative dispute resolution. If a resolution cannot be reached, the court will hold a hearing and make a decision based on the evidence presented.

Child Custody and Visitation

Child custody and visitation are among the most emotionally charged issues that are handled by the Essex County Family Court. When determining custody, the court considers several factors, including the best interests of the child, the relationship between the child and each parent, and each parent's ability to provide a stable and loving home for the child. Visitation schedules and parenting time are also important considerations and are designed to ensure that the child has ongoing relationships with both parents.

Child Support

The Essex County Family Court is responsible for enforcing child support orders and ensuring that children receive the financial support they need from both parents. The court uses a set of guidelines to calculate child support payments and will enforce support orders if necessary.

Domestic Violence and Orders of Protection

Domestic violence is a serious issue that is taken very seriously by the Essex County Family Court. Victims of domestic violence can obtain an order of protection, which is a court order that restricts the abuser's contact with the victim. If the order is violated, the court can take enforcement action, including arrest and imprisonment.

Division of Marital Property and Assets

When a marriage ends, the Essex County Family Court is responsible for dividing the couple's assets and property in a fair and equitable manner. The court uses the principle of equitable distribution to divide marital property, taking into account factors such as the length of the marriage, each spouse's income and earning potential, and any contributions made to the marriage.

Alimony/Spousal Support

In some cases, one spouse may be required to provide financial support to the other after a divorce. The Essex County Family Court will consider several factors when determining the amount and duration of alimony, including the length of the marriage, each spouse's income and earning potential, and the standard of living established during the marriage.

Adoption

The Essex County Family Court is responsible for overseeing adoptions in the county. There are several types of adoptions, including stepparent adoptions, agency adoptions, and international adoptions. The court will ensure that all adoption requirements are met and that the best interests of the child are protected.

Paternity

Establishing paternity is an important step in determining a child's legal rights and responsibilities. The Essex County Family Court can help establish paternity through DNA testing and other means.

Juvenile Delinquency

The Essex County Family Court also handles juvenile delinquency cases, which involve minors who are accused of committing crimes. The court works to protect the rights of juveniles and to provide them with the resources and support they need to stay on the right path.

Representation in Family Court

Individuals who are involved in family court cases are encouraged to seek legal representation. This can be done by hiring a private attorney, representing oneself pro se, or by being appointed a court-appointed attorney.

Appeal from Family Court Decisions

In some cases, individuals may wish to appeal a family court decision. The Essex County Family Court allows appeals under certain circumstances and provides guidelines for the appeal process.

Essex County Family Court Phone Number

The phone number for the Essex County Family Court is (973) 621-4700. This number can be used to reach the main office of the family court, where you can speak with a representative and get answers to your questions.

Essex County Family Court Records

The Essex County Family Court maintains records of all cases that are heard in the court. These records are public and can be accessed by anyone who has a legitimate interest in the information. To access family court records, you can visit the court in person or make a request by mail.

Essex County Court Case Lookup

To look up a case in the Essex County Family Court, you can use the online case search tool provided by the court. This tool allows you to search for cases by case number, party name, or attorney name. You can also view case information, including case status, court dates, and case documents.

Essex County Family Court Judges

The Essex County Family Court is staffed by a team of dedicated and experienced judges who are responsible for hearing and deciding family law cases. These judges have extensive training and experience in family law and are committed to ensuring that all cases are handled fairly and justly.

Essex Probate and Family Court Docket

The Essex Probate and Family Court maintains a docket of all cases that are heard in the court. This docket includes information on case dates, case numbers, and case status. To access the docket, you can visit the court in person or make a request by mail.

Essex County Divorce Records

The Essex County Family Court maintains records of all divorce cases that are heard in the court. These records are public and can be accessed by anyone who has a legitimate interest in the information. To access divorce records, you can visit the court in person or make a request by mail.

Conclusion

The Essex County Family Court plays a critical role in protecting the rights and interests of families and children in the county. Understanding the family court system and the services it provides is important for anyone who may be involved in a family court case. If you have questions or concerns about a family law matter, it is recommended that you seek the assistance of a qualified attorney.

FAQs

What is the purpose of Essex County Family Court?

The purpose of Essex County Family Court is to provide a specialized forum for the resolution of family law issues, including divorce and separation, child custody and support, domestic violence, adoption, and juvenile delinquency.

What types of cases does Essex County Family Court hear?

Essex County Family Court hears a wide range of family law cases, including divorce and separation, child custody and support, domestic violence, adoption, and juvenile delinquency.

How does the adjudication process work in Essex County Family Court?

The adjudication process in Essex County Family Court typically involves several stages, including pre-trial proceedings, trial proceedings, and post-trial proceedings, and an appeal process is available for parties who are dissatisfied with the outcome of their case.

What are the benefits of using Essex County Family Court?

The benefits of using Essex County Family Court include a quick resolution of disputes, a cost-effective solution, specialized expertise in family law matters, and a strong emphasis on child welfare.

What steps can I take to prepare for a hearing in Essex County Family Court?

To prepare for a hearing in Essex County Family Court, individuals should gather all relevant information and evidence, consider hiring an attorney or utilizing mediation services, and familiarize themselves with the court procedures and the law that applies to their case.
